title: فلاي دبي تعزز عملياتها في إيطاليا بزيادة عدد الرحلات إلى نابولي وميلانو
text:
flydubai strengthens operations in Italy with increased frequency to Naples and Milan
flydubai, the Dubai-based carrier, has increased its daily operations between Dubai and Naples and is set to boost its flights to Milan-Bergamo to a double-daily operation from 31 July, further enhancing passenger connectivity to Italy and expanding its offering to its network in Europe.
Due to scheduled maintenance works at Naples International Airport (NAP), the airline will temporarily operate daily flights from Dubai International (DXB) to Salerno Costa d’Amalfi and Cilento Airport (QSR) from 01 to 30 November 2026, before resuming services to Naples International Airport (NAP) from 01 December.
During this period, passengers with existing bookings to Naples will be automatically rebooked onto flights to Salerno, ensuring their journeys continue without disruption. The temporary switch offers seamless connectivity for passengers travelling between Dubai and Naples, while reinforcing Dubai’s role as a global hub for travel, trade and tourism.
With the increased frequencies, the carrier will serve Italy with a double-daily frequency to Milan-Bergamo, daily flights to Naples, thrice-weekly flights to Catania, alongside seasonal summer flights to Olbia, operating twice weekly until the end of August.
Ghaith Al Ghaith, Chief Executive Officer at flydubai, said: “Naples and Milan have become key gateways into our Italian network and we are pleased to have expanded the frequency of our operations to both cities. Our priority is to ensure customers continue to enjoy convenient access to the region, in line with our long-term commitment to strengthening connectivity to underserved destinations and supporting the continued flow of trade, tourism and people between the United Arab Emirates and Italy, particularly as travel demand increases during the winter season.”
Jeyhun Efendi, Divisional Senior Vice President of Commercial Operations and E-commerce at flydubai, added: “Our commitment to further strengthening our direct services to Naples and Milan-Bergamo underscores the importance of the Italian market and our commitment to offering customers seamless, non-stop access to key destinations across Italy and beyond. Through our Dubai hub and the combined reach of the flydubai and Emirates networks, we now offer passengers even more travel options to some of the world’s most sought-after destinations, with seamless connections to Kenya, Oman, the Maldives, Sri Lanka, Zanzibar and many more. We look forward to welcoming our customers on board as we connect our destinations in Italy with our expanding network.”
As part of its ongoing network expansion, flydubai has recently launched services to Aleppo in Syria, Bangkok in Thailand and Benghazi in Libya, with direct flights to Pokhara in Nepal set to commence on 23 September, further enhancing connectivity to key destinations across the Middle East and Southeast Asia.
The flydubai experience
Passengers travelling with flydubai can enjoy an elevated onboard experience across the carrier's modern fleet of Boeing 737 aircraft.
This includes lie-flat seats in Business Class and ergonomically designed seats in Economy Class, ensuring a comfortable and restful journey, with a wide selection of internationally inspired dining options, light snacks and refreshments served throughout the flight, alongside hours of inflight entertainment, available for passengers across all cabins at no additional cost.
flydubai will also soon introduce Starlink high-speed connectivity across its fleet, further enhancing the passenger experience across its growing network.
Flight details
The Naples and Milan-Bergamo services are operated under the flydubai and Emirates codeshare partnership, offering passengers the convenience of streamlined itineraries, single-ticket bookings and through-checked baggage.
Flights will temporarily operate daily from Terminal 3 at Dubai International (DXB) to Salerno Costa d’Amalfi and Cilento Airport (QSR) from 01 to 30 November 2026, before services resume to Naples International Airport (NAP) from 01 December 2026.
Return Business Class fares from DXB to QSR start from AED 14,135 and Economy Class Lite fares start from AED 2,885.
Return Business Class fares from QSR to DXB start from EUR 3,080 and Economy Class Lite fares start from EUR 610.
Flights are available for booking on flydubai.com, the official flydubai app, via the UAE Contact Centre at (+971) 600 54 44 45, at flydubai travel shops, or through travel partners.
For the full timetable, please visit flydubai.com/en/flying-with-us/timetable
Background Information
flydubai
flydubai began operations in 2009 with the aim of taking more people to more places, more often. In just a few years, flydubai has firmly established its place in the region. Today, we fly to more than 90 destinations operating out of Dubai International (DXB) and Al Maktoum International (DWC). We’re creating opportunities for travel, tourism and trade across the region. By opening up new markets, we’re changing the way people look at travel while contributing to the growth of Dubai as an aviation hub.
